original_ai_output.title_zh: 阿布贾商会就翁多州军机坠毁事件向总统及军方致哀
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 阿布贾工商会（ACCI）就尼日利亚空军一架飞机在翁多州伊格博科达海军基地附近坠毁一事，向总统博拉·蒂努布、武装部队及遇难者家属表示哀悼。ACCI主席奥贝戈卢称事故造成军人、家属及机组人员死亡，并呼吁彻查事故原因以防再次发生。该报道为单一来源。

location.raw_text: Igbokoda, Ilaje Local Government Area, Ondo State, near the naval base area

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚空军一架飞机在翁多州伊格博科达海军基地附近坠毁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the Nigerian Air Force aircraft crashed on Monday near the naval base area in Igbokoda, Ilaje Local Government Area on Ondo State

key_facts.fact: 事故造成军人、家属及机组人员死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the incident, which claimed the lives of military personnel, family members and crew

key_facts.fact: 阿布贾工商会向总统蒂努布、武装部队及遇难者家属致哀
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Abuja Chamber of Commerce and Industry (ACCI) has commiserated with President Bola Tinubu, the Armed Forces and families of victims of the Ondo plane crash

key_facts.fact: ACCI主席呼吁彻查事故原因以防再次发生
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The ACCI president called for a thorough investigation into the circumstances surrounding the crash to establish its cause

uncertainties: 事故原因尚未确定，有待调查
该事件目前仅有一个来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
